mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates applied to future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises over the past month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 5.0% by >0.5pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% annualized and stagnation in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% signals persistent inflation without adequate policy response, compressing real equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) during supply contraction signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS above 150,000) signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises above 150,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST below 800.0) signals weakening consumer demand for housing, reducing construction activity and related sector earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 800.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 800.0) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 7.5%) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 800.0 and UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising at least 0.25% monthly) increase the cost of capital, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS rising cycles, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
